entry_gate: G8 report, audit and immutable stage snapshot saved; review cross-recognizer findings before freezing any new experiment
rationale: The light adaptation has only been compared with other neural adaptation controls. Add a mature signal-processing comparator before proposing a new module or calling the result innovative.
classical_paper: Souden, Benesty and Affes. On Optimal Frequency-Domain Multichannel Linear Filtering for Noise Reduction. IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing18(2),260-276,February2010; DOI online record2009. https://doi.org/10.1109/TASL.2009.2025790
existing_library: Installed torchaudio2.5.1+cu121, use official PSD/SoudenMVDR implementation; no new dependency or trained weights
main_candidate: McNet-estimated speech/noise masks -> multichannel speech/noise PSD -> official Souden MVDR at reference channel4. Estimated residual is noisy reference minus saved McNet waveform. Fix squared-ratio mask, STFT and diagonal loading before scoring; no use of clean target or true target angle in this main comparator.
optional_diagnostics: Oracle-DOA delay-and-sum using simulator direction; explicitly privileged information, not deployable blind baseline
Oracle-reference IRM Souden MVDR using true reference and residual; diagnostic of mask limitations only, never a fair learned-system competitor
scope_if_activated: Reuse frozen G5/G7 waves/inputs and registered scoring rules; no new data/training/weight selection. Analyze direction/noise/SNR and both fixed ASR backends. Predeclare exact subset and all numerical settings before outputs.
required_checks: STFT/ISTFT identity and exact lengths, reference index and complex conjugation
Finite weights/output for silent or degenerate covariance cases, predetermined diagonal loading; failures retained rather than metric-based fallback
Unit response on a synthetic plane-wave target, interference attenuation measured without scoring-driven tuning
Explicit separation of estimated-mask main result and oracle diagnostics
Report both computation and prior McNet-mask generation cost
novelty: Mature baseline addition and mechanism diagnosis, not a proposed new algorithm or publication guarantee
